definition_en: Labour force as a share of the population aged 20-64, Labour Force Survey.
Share of people aged 25-64 who took part in education or training in the four weeks before the survey.

name_en: At risk of poverty or social exclusion
definition_en: Share of people at risk of poverty, severely materially and socially deprived or living in a household with very low work intensity (EU-SILC, EU 2030 definition).

name_en: Children at risk of poverty or social exclusion
name_pl: Dzieci zagrożone ubóstwem lub wykluczeniem społecznym
definition_en: At-risk-of-poverty-or-social-exclusion rate of people under 18 (EU-SILC, EU 2030 definition).
Share of individuals aged 16-74 with at least basic overall digital skills (ICT usage survey, every two years).
Long-term government bond yield used for the EMU convergence criterion, monthly average.
Gross domestic product per inhabitant in purchasing power standards, as a percentage of the EU27 average; countries and NUTS 2 regions.
Gross domestic expenditure on research and development, all sectors of performance, as a percentage of GDP.

name_pl: Dług sektora instytucji rządowych i samorządowych
definition_en: Consolidated gross debt of general government (Maastricht definition) as a percentage of GDP.

name_pl: Wynik sektora instytucji rządowych i samorządowych
definition_en: Net lending (+) or net borrowing (-) of general government as a percentage of GDP; a deficit is negative.
Total greenhouse gas emissions in CO2 equivalent, excluding land use (LULUCF), including international aviation.

name_en: Young people not in employment or education (NEET)
definition_en: Share of people aged 15-29 neither in employment nor in education or training, Labour Force Survey.
Net external financial assets minus liabilities of the economy as a percentage of GDP (MIP scoreboard).
Population aged 65 and over per 100 people aged 15-64 on 1 January.
Recycled municipal waste as a share of municipal waste generated.
Nominal effective exchange rate deflated by consumer prices against 42 trading partners, 2020 = 100; a rise is a real appreciation.
Share of people aged 25-34 with tertiary education (ISCED 5-8).
Mean number of children a woman would have in her lifetime at the age-specific fertility rates of the year.

name_pl: Wskaźnik cen towarów i usług konsumpcyjnych (CPI), zmiana roczna
definition_en: Change in the prices of consumer goods and services against the same period a year earlier, national CPI of Statistics Poland (GUS); EU comparison is the HICP.
Average monthly gross wage deflated by the CPI, same period of the previous year = 100 (GUS).
Average monthly gross wage, same period of the previous year = 100, current prices (GUS).
Unemployed persons registered at labour offices at the end of the month.

name_en: GDP growth, quarter on quarter (seasonally adjusted)
name_pl: Dynamika PKB kwartał do kwartału (wyrównana sezonowo)
definition_en: Change in real GDP against the previous quarter, seasonally and calendar adjusted.
Change in real gross domestic product (or gross value added) of a region against the previous year.

name_pl: Stopa inwestycji (nakłady brutto na środki trwałe, % PKB)
definition_en: Gross fixed capital formation as a percentage of GDP.

name_pl: Dynamika realna inwestycji (nakłady brutto na środki trwałe)
definition_en: Change in real gross fixed capital formation against the same quarter a year earlier.
Contribution of household and government consumption, gross capital formation, exports and imports to real GDP growth on the same quarter a year earlier, in percentage points.
Gross value added at current prices, total of all NACE sections (sections as breakdown).

name_en: Gross fixed capital formation by asset
name_pl: Nakłady brutto na środki trwałe według rodzajów aktywów
definition_en: Gross fixed capital formation at current prices, total of all fixed assets (asset types as breakdown).
Balance of answers of industrial firms on production expectations, order books and stocks (EU harmonised business survey, seasonally adjusted).
Current level of capacity utilisation reported by industrial firms (EU harmonised business survey, seasonally adjusted).
Balance of consumers' assessments of their financial situation, the economy and major purchases (EU harmonised survey; GUS current consumer confidence indicator BWUK).
Composite of industry, services, consumer, construction and retail confidence, long-term average = 100.
Change in the volume of industrial production (NACE B-D) against the same month a year earlier.
Change in the volume of construction output against the same month a year earlier.
Change in the volume of retail trade sales against the same month a year earlier (constant prices).

name_en: Producer prices in industry, annual change
name_pl: Ceny produkcji sprzedanej przemysłu, zmiana roczna
definition_en: Change in industrial producer prices on the domestic market against the same month a year earlier.
Current account balance of the balance of payments as a percentage of GDP.
Balances of goods, services, primary and secondary income and the current account, million EUR.
Net incurrence of direct investment liabilities (inward direct investment) in the year.
Job vacancies as a percentage of occupied posts and job vacancies, NACE B-S.
Change in real GDP per person employed against the same quarter a year earlier.
Change in nominal unit labour cost (per person) against the same quarter a year earlier.
People unemployed for 12 months or more as a percentage of the labour force aged 15-74.

name_pl: Luka płacowa między kobietami i mężczyznami (nieskorygowana)
definition_en: Difference between average gross hourly earnings of men and women as a percentage of men's earnings, NACE B-S except O.
Inequality of equivalised disposable income, 0 = full equality, 100 = full inequality.
General government expenditure on social protection (COFOG 10) as a percentage of GDP.
Unemployed people aged 15-24 (Eurostat monthly: under 25) as a percentage of the labour force of that age.
Average monthly disposable income per person in households (household budget survey).
Average number of people receiving old-age and disability pensions.
Average monthly gross old-age pension paid by the non-agricultural social insurance system (ZUS).
Investment outlays of enterprises, current prices.
Registered unemployed per job offer received by labour offices.
